scene:
FOUR separate illustrations on one page in a 2x2 grid, divided by single hard straight black ink borders ruled exactly down the vertical middle and across the horizontal middle of the image, edge to edge. The illustrations do not bleed into each other and there is no margin around the outside of the page.

TOP LEFT panel: a single desktop computer standing alone on a bare floor with nothing plugged into it at all, its cable lying loose and unconnected on the ground beside it — a machine that works but knows only itself.

TOP RIGHT panel: two people standing far apart in an empty landscape, each with a faint glow at the chest, and between the two glows a single taut line of light running the whole distance — nothing else connects them and neither one is speaking.

BOTTOM LEFT panel: a very close view of the mouth of one glass jar of water, and the water inside drawn as though it is holding the shape of a spoken word — faint concentric rings frozen mid-spread across its surface.

BOTTOM RIGHT panel: the inside of a house with no one in it — furniture still in place, dust thick on every surface, damp climbing the wallpaper and a slow buckle in the floorboards, the decay drawn as something that happened because the rooms were empty.

No text or lettering anywhere.

FOUR separate illustrations on one page in a 2x2 grid, divided by single hard straight black ink borders ruled exactly down the vertical middle and across the horizontal middle of the image, edge to edge. The illustrations do not bleed into each other and there is no margin around the outside of the page.

TOP LEFT panel: an enormous web of lines and nodes filling the whole panel like a night map of a continent, and one tiny human figure standing inside it with the lines running straight through and past them in every direction — the whole thing at once, and one person in it.

TOP RIGHT panel: a crowded street of ordinary people walking, and above and between their heads a dense weather of soft floating shapes drifting from person to person, the shapes not seen by anybody in the picture.

BOTTOM LEFT panel: two open glass jars of cooked rice photographed the way a record is kept, thirty days on — the left jar pale and intact, the right jar dark and furred over and collapsing in on itself.

BOTTOM RIGHT panel: a human figure lying on a bed drawn in the same state as a long-abandoned room — the body still whole but the air around it dusty and still, the light through the window flat and grey, everything drawn as slowly running down.

No text or lettering anywhere.
